body: Quick pass: the PR merges cleanly with `main`. The author reports `cargo xtask gate test ai_chat --crate camcraft-ui` and `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` green on head `512d0e7a3`, pinned by `post_confirmation_allow_and_deny_gate_mcp_dispatch`. The change is in the test wait loops only. The confirmation gate and the assertions are not changed. The body is complete. The full review comes next.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 512d0e7a3ade186e2a337856d08ef88f58c8cfa6 -->

Ready for the maintainer to merge.

**Head and merge.** Head `512d0e7a3ade186e2a337856d08ef88f58c8cfa6`. The head merges into current main with no conflicts. #2142 was built and tested on top of #2147, because main does not build camcraft-ui alone.

**Test results.** All runs were local, in a worktree of main + #2147 + #2142, with `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4`.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib ai_chat`: 20 passed, 0 failed.
- `egui_app::tests::ai_chat::safety` module: 4 passed in each of three runs.
- `post_confirmation_allow_and_deny_gate_mcp_dispatch`: 1 passed in each of three runs.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean, no warnings.

**Assertions are preserved.** The diff changes only the helper functions in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/ai_chat/mod.rs`. The test files `safety.rs`, `basic.rs` and `regressions.rs` are the same as on main. The pump loops keep the same wait conditions and the same 5 s timeouts with the same assert messages. They now call `step()` once per loop pass. `run()` panicked after four repaints; `step()` lets the loop wait on a slow runner. The gate checks still run after the helpers: the "Confirmation required" label check, the "Tool: post" label check, "no file write before Allow", "no file write after Deny", and the denial with `is_error` fed back to the model. A helper change cannot skip these asserts, and none was removed.

**Non-blocking note.** In `regressions.rs`, the screenshot refusal test asserts right after `submit_prompt`, with no pump call after. The new `run_steps(2)` settles two frames, where the old `run()` settled more. The assert does not depend on a repaint count. Two frames processed the send click in all nine runs here.

**Law checks.** The body is complete: the `Changelog: none` line, and `Fixes #2137` at the end. The PR changes no process file, no `Cargo.toml`, no `build.rs`, no `.github` file, and no snapshot PNG. No new `unwrap`, `expect` or panic outside tests. The added comments are plain English.
